# AERO-SENTINEL

> Professional, free aviation weather monitoring platform providing real-time TAF, METAR, and SPECI alerts for pilots, dispatchers, and aviation professionals. No account required.

Last updated: 2026-07-05

## Site Information

- **URL**: https://aerosentinel.app
- **Type**: Web Application (SPA / PWA)
- **Category**: Aviation Weather Monitoring
- **Language**: English
- **Pricing**: Free to use — no subscription, no account required
- **Airports**: Supports 7,000+ ICAO-coded airports worldwide

## Key Pages

- [Dashboard](https://aerosentinel.app/) — Real-time TAF/METAR monitoring dashboard with personalized airport watchlists, flight category classification (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR), and critical weather indicators
- [Alerts](https://aerosentinel.app/alerts) — Weather alert management: TAF amendments, corrections, SPECI reports, category changes, and critical weather notifications with push alerts
- [Airports](https://aerosentinel.app/airports) — Global airport weather browser, Excel flight plan upload, and automated ETA-window TAF analysis for flight planning
- [Blog](https://aerosentinel.app/blog) — Aviation weather guides: TAF decoding, METAR reading, wind shear, turbulence, visibility, ICAO codes, and more
- [Features](https://aerosentinel.app/features) — Platform features: TAF monitoring, METAR parser, weather alerts, flight analysis, personalized watchlists, global airport coverage
- [Use Cases](https://aerosentinel.app/use-cases) — How pilots, dispatchers, aviation students, aircraft operators, and weather enthusiasts use AERO-SENTINEL
- [FAQ](https://aerosentinel.app/faq) — Frequently asked questions about the platform
- [About](https://aerosentinel.app/about) — About AERO-SENTINEL
- [Contact](https://aerosentinel.app/contact) — Contact and support

## Features

- **TAF Monitoring**: Continuous Terminal Aerodrome Forecast tracking with instant change detection and visual diff comparison
- **METAR Parser**: Real-time METAR decoding with human-readable translations, coded group explanations, and flight category classification
- **SPECI Alerts**: Immediate notifications for special weather observations triggered by rapid condition changes
- **Weather Alerts**: Intelligent alert system detecting wind speed changes, visibility drops, ceiling reductions, new weather phenomena (TS, WS, FZ), and category transitions
- **Flight Analysis**: Excel flight plan upload with automated ETA-window TAF analysis, multi-airport comparison, and historical trend tracking
- **Personalized Watchlists**: Custom airport monitoring lists stored locally — no account or login required
- **Global Coverage**: 7,000+ airports with ICAO-standard weather data from official sources
- **Push Notifications**: Browser push alerts for critical weather changes, even when the tab is in the background
- **PWA Support**: Installable as a Progressive Web App for mobile and desktop kiosk use

## Data Sources

Weather data originates from the [NOAA Aviation Weather Center](https://www.aviationweather.gov/) (aviationweather.gov) and international ICAO-standard aviation weather data providers. All METAR, TAF, and SPECI reports are issued by certified weather observers and licensed meteorologists at airport meteorological stations worldwide. AERO-SENTINEL does not fabricate, modify, or interpolate weather data — raw report text is preserved alongside decoded presentations for verification.

## Important Disclaimer

AERO-SENTINEL is a supplementary weather monitoring and situational awareness tool. It is not an official flight planning service and should not be used as the sole source for flight planning decisions. Always consult official sources including your flight service provider, approved weather briefing services, and applicable regulatory requirements.

## Allowed Paths

- All public pages are open to crawling and indexing
- API endpoints (`/api/*`) are internal and not intended for LLM or third-party access
